title: elymus fontqueri
intro: Elymus fontqueri, commonly known as Fontquer's wheatgrass, is a species of perennial grass native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The health benefits of Elymus fontqueri are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may help protect against oxidative stress and cellular damage. The bioactive constituents of Elymus fontqueri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
